findings.desc: quality-cleanup: codex-adapter-checks.ts:77-81 resolveCodexSessionBriefCommand uses a fragile magic-suffix string slice (verifyCommand.slice(0, -" verify_codex".length)) to derive the session_brief command. The fallback at line 80 is hardcoded to "node bin/lattice-codex.js session_brief" regardless of project branding. If a future resolve candidate does not end with " verify_codex" (e.g. "lattice codex verify" which is already returned by the global-thin branch of resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand), koala-branded projects would silently receive lattice-branded guidance. The invariant that all resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand outputs end with " verify_codex" is implicit and has no dedicated test coverage protecting it.
